block.creategravitybatteries.gravity_bat: Stores rotational power as _height_. Winds a glued _weight_ up while the network has capacity to spare, and lets it back down to _drive the shaft_ when the network runs short.
Takes hold of the structure hanging below it, and keeps hold of it. Right-click again to let go.
While the network has spare capacity
Draws the surplus and winds the weight _up_. Either direction of rotation charges it.
Lets the weight _down_ and supplies the missing capacity, until the weight runs into something.
The _weight_ is how much power it supplies. The _drop_ is how long it lasts.
creategravitybatteries.assembly.no_actor:

creategravitybatteries.ponder.gravity_ba: Glue a heavy structure together beneath a Gravity Battery. Its size is the battery's power rating
Activating the battery takes hold of whatever is hanging below it. It does not let go again
While the rest of the network has stress capacity to spare, the battery draws it and winds the weight up
When the rest of the network can no longer carry its own load, the battery lets the weight back down
The descent drives the shaft. Turn a battery either way and it charges; only the network's balance decides when it discharges
It falls until it runs into something, and stops there. The drop is how long the battery lasts; the weight is how much power it gives
